[[Chandrex Grenn]]'s '''sister''' was present at an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] naval base on [[Shadren V]] when it was attacked by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces. She went missing in the attack and her brother began searching the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for her.
